accessibility.text: 1. If God exists, then God is omnipotent.
2. If something is omnipotent, it can do anything.
3. If God exists, then God can do anything. (1,2)
4. If God exists, then God is wholly good.
5. If something is wholly good, it always eliminates as much evil as it can.
6. If God exists, then God eliminates as much evil as God can. (4,5)
7. If God exists, then God eliminates all evil. (3,6)
8. If God exists, then there is no evil. (7)
9. Some evil exists.
C. God does not exist. (8,9)
